metadata.title: Generalized Discrete Fractal Dimensions of Graph Families
metadata.abstract: Quantifying the self-similarity of complex networks via discrete fractal dimensions is a fundamental problem in network science. In this paper, we investigate some general fractal dimensions of graph families based on q-energy and Rényi entropy. We first establish several bounds for the energy, and then discuss the monotonicity, measure invariance of the dimensions, as well as some concrete graph families.

analysis.progressType: 图族的离散广义分形维数
analysis.workSummary: 以 q-energy 和 Rényi 熵定义并研究图族的一些广义离散分形维数，建立能量界，讨论维数单调性、测度不变性及具体图族例子。
analysis.breakthrough: 为网络自相似性提供一组带参数的离散维数工具及基本性质。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未列精确维数定义、参数范围或全部极限存在性，不能声称统一解决所有网络分形维数；离散测度不变性也不能直接推广到任意连续度量测度空间。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
